subject.title: fix: keep dynamic model switching and agent catalogs reliable

question: Should an empty model overlay on the configured default provider deliberately cause OpenClaw to select the first configured provider with a model for existing installations?
rationale: This is a compatibility and provider-routing policy choice: the branch intentionally changes the fallback selected by runtime, status, and doctor, and tests alone cannot establish whether every existing configuration should receive that new behavior.

options.title: Confirm the new fallback contract
options.body: Keep the branch’s normalized fallback behavior and require redacted real-session proof that runtime, status, and doctor agree for a configured custom provider.

options.title: Preserve the default-provider preference
options.body: Revise the fallback so an existing default-provider overlay remains preferred unless an explicit supported configuration establishes a different selected model.

recommendation.title: Confirm the new fallback contract
recommendation.body: Keep the branch’s normalized fallback behavior and require redacted real-session proof that runtime, status, and doctor agree for a configured custom provider.
